name: Neterra Pleven
notes: Aggregator and PeeringDB (fac 14608, Neterra Pleven) listings identify an operational Neterra colocation facility in Pleven; no primary operator facility page found. ESO data (Economic.bg, 2026-08-12) show ~1.14 GW declared data-center grid-connection interest in Pleven province, indicating active pipeline.

name: Brinell Compute AI Data Center (Rakovski Industrial Zone / Maritsa)
notes: DCD (2026-07-30): Brinell Compute announced construction of an AI data center on 2,000 acres (809 ha) in Rakovski Industrial Zone, municipality of Maritsa, Plovdiv province, will begin Fall 2026; EUR 3bn investment, capacity not disclosed. Council of Ministers MoU signed January 2026. ESO data (Economic.bg 2026-08-12) show Plovdiv has the largest declared data-center grid-connection interest in Bulgaria (~2.26 GW).

name: CETIN Bulgaria Trakia Data Center
notes: CETIN Bulgaria official pages confirm it built photovoltaic plants on its Serdika (Sofia) and Trakia (Plovdiv) data centers; Trakia DC is a named CETIN facility in the Plovdiv/Trakia Economic Zone.

name: Evolink Data Center Plovdiv
notes: Evolink official page states it operates four data centers in Sofia, Plovdiv and Varna; DataCenterMap lists the Plovdiv site separately. Capacity not disclosed.

name: TSBG Plovdiv Data Center
notes: Aggregator listings identify an operational TSBG colocation/data-center facility in Plovdiv; no primary operator facility page found.

name: Plovdiv Teleport Center
notes: DataCenterMap lists Plovdiv Teleport Center as a facility; NetIX/Neterra network materials reference Bulgarian connectivity/PoPs, but public facility details are limited (directory-grade lead).

name: VueNow Plovdiv edge data center (Plovdiv Tech Park hub)
notes: 2021 VueNow MoU planned a 100-rack hub in Plovdiv Tech Park plus edge sites; stale MoU lead per BG methodology, no construction/permit evidence found.

name: Neterra Razgrad
notes: Aggregator listings identify an operational Neterra colocation/data-center facility in Razgrad; no primary operator facility page found.

name: SDC Ruse (Neterra / Sofia Data Center)
notes: Neterra official SDC page describes SDC Ruse as a Tier III carrier-neutral data center in Ruse near the Romanian border, main PoP for the Black Sea Fiber Optic Ring; DataCenterMap lists ~0.13 MW. Operator page confirms existence/location (A); capacity figure from directory (C-level detail).

name: Neterra Sliven
notes: Aggregator listings identify an operational Neterra colocation/data-center facility in Sliven; no primary operator facility page found.

name: Digital Realty / Telepoint Sofia East
notes: Digital Realty entered Bulgaria 2026-03-02 via Telepoint acquisition, including two Sofia data centers; Sofia East is the large carrier-neutral Telepoint Sofia facility (110+ network providers, cloud on-ramps).

name: Digital Realty / Telepoint Sofia Centre
notes: Digital Realty's Telepoint acquisition covered two Sofia data centers; Data Center Platform lists TELEPOINT Sofia Centre at 122 Ovcho Pole Street with 113 networks and nine exchanges connected.

name: Equinix Sofia SO1/SO2
notes: Equinix official Bulgaria page states two network-dense, carrier-neutral data centers in Sofia (SO1 in Druzhba-1, SO2 at Nedelcho Bonchev), about 35,000 sq ft / 3,215 sq m colocation total.

name: Neterra SDC 1 (Sofia Data Center)
notes: Neterra SDC brand page lists SDC 1 and SDC 2 in Sofia; SDC 2 opening announcement confirms SDC 2 is located next to SDC 1 on a common Sofia campus.

name: Neterra SDC 2 (Sofia Data Center)
notes: Neterra opened SDC 2 in Sofia in 2022 (Tier III, >1,400 sq m, 2 MW installed capacity) next to SDC 1; operator and DCD confirm.

name: A1 Lift data center / Exoscale BG-SOF-1 zone
notes: Exoscale lists BG-SOF-1 cloud zone hosted at A1 Lift (3 Nedelcho Bonchev St, Sofia); A1 markets A1 Data Center colocation/hosting. This is a commercial cloud/colo zone, not a hyperscaler region.

name: Daticum Sofia Data Centre
notes: Daticum official page offers cloud, dedicated server and colocation services from 135 Tsarigradsko Shose Blvd, Sofia; directory listings confirm the Sofia colocation site.

name: Evolink Data Center Sofia 1 and Sofia 2
notes: Evolink official page states it built and operates four data centers in Sofia, Plovdiv and Varna, with Sofia 2 the newest carrier-neutral facility; Sofia 1 and Sofia 2 are BIX peering facilities per PeeringDB.

name: CETIN Bulgaria Serdika DC
notes: CETIN International/Bulgaria official releases name Serdika DC in Sofia among CETIN Bulgaria data centers equipped with PV systems; existence/location confirmed by operator, colocation availability/capacity unverified.

name: BRAIN++ AI Factory (Sofia Tech Park, INSAIT)
developer: INSAIT / Sofia Tech Park (EU AI Factory)
notes: Official Sofia Tech Park/INSAIT/SeeNews: BRAIN++ AI factory at Sofia Tech Park comprises Discoverer++ supercomputer plus AI data-center facility; construction begins 2026, completion within three years, EUR 90M EU project with 50% national co-funding. Public/HPC compute infrastructure, not commercial colo.

name: 3DC neutral data center
notes: Legacy news item: 3DC launched as one of the first neutral colocation data centers in Bulgaria with a BGN 5M NEVEQ-backed investment; treated as a directory/legacy Sofia seed (C) per BG methodology, current operations unverified.

name: (market context) Sofia-city declared DC grid interest
notes: ESO data via Economic.bg (2026-08-12): ~920 MW of declared data-center grid-connection applications/investment proposals in Sofia-city out of 9.33 GW national total; unnamed investors, so recorded as market-level context only.

name: Neterra SDC Stolnik / Data Center Park Stolnik
notes: Neterra lists SDC Stolnik among its four SDC facilities; operator news places Stolnik near a major substation about 20 minutes from Sofia Airport as part of Data Center Park Stolnik. Assigned to Sofia province (not Sofia city) per BG methodology.

name: Vivacom / Eutelsat OneWeb Stara Zagora ground station mini data centre
notes: United Group official: Stara Zagora ground station (18 antennas) includes a mini data centre connecting LEO satellites to optical networks/data centers; commissioned 2023. Satellite ground-station data-center infrastructure, not standard colo. ESO data (Economic.bg 2026-08-12) show ~510 MW declared DC grid interest in Stara Zagora (unnamed).

name: ESCOM Haskovo data center
notes: Data Center Platform and Inflect list ESCOM Haskovo as an operating colocation/data center facility; ESCOM site confirms company address in Haskovo but public facility detail is limited.

name: TSBG Kapitan Andreevo data center
notes: Facility listings place a carrier-neutral colocation/data center at 3 Bialo More Street, Kapitan Andreevo (Haskovo province) with interconnection to local and international networks; directory-grade lead only.
